text:
alex: FYI after the Cilium 1.14 rollout to us-east-1 GPU pool we're seeing intermittent pod-to-pod packet loss and 10-50ms spikes during NCCL all-reduce. Affects ~20% of GPU nodes. Symptoms: training jobs failing with timeouts.
maria: did the rollout include eBPF offload and ENI jumbo frames? we toggled xdp in the chart.
samir: I can confirm. Observed MTU drops on the tunnel interface (cilium_vxlan) to 1450 on impacted nodes; other nodes still 1500.
julia: can you paste iperf and one tcpdump snippet?
alex: pasted command outputs:
```
# iperf3 -c 10.0.4.12 -P 4
[SUM]   0.00-10.00  sec  1.21 GBytes   1.04 Gbits/sec  sender
```
alex: tcpdump shows lots of retransmits and "fragmented-ip" on eth0 -> cilium_vxlan.
devops-bot: deploybot: rollout 1.14 started at 2026-03-16T03:00Z, staged 40% clusters.
kevin: could be MTU mismatch from tunnel header + GSO offloading; try disabling TSO/GSO on the pod host as quick test: `ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off gro off`.
maria: temporary fix worked on node-7 — turning off GSO reduced packet loss.
samir: But disabling GSO kills throughput for InfiniBand RDMA? we rely on mlx5; be careful.
julia: Are we using vxlan or geneve? cilium's default now is geneve with ~50 byte extra header; that plus jumbo frames messed with our physical network MTU 9000 for RoCE.
alex: Note: GPU nodes use MTU 9000 on IB and macvlan for RDMA, internal overlay should respect that. After upgrade, cilium's tunnel negotiation didn't set proper path MTU.
maria: Suggest immediate remediation: rollback Cilium to 1.13 in affected ASG and pin nodes; then plan patch: enable cilium.encapMTU or set host-reachable services offload.
samir: Also try `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` as stopgap and enable `cilium.policy.enforce=false` to rule out policy drops.
kevin: I've opened a support ticket with Cilium: https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/12345. They asked for pcap + log-collector output.
alex: I'm collecting logs: /var/log/cilium/cilium.log + pcap from node-7 and node-9. Will attach.
julia: For canary, recommend 1) cordon & drain 2) rollback daemonset to 1.13 3) reboot node network stack if kernel module stuck.
maria: Also check iptables vs nft mismatch — kube-proxy ipvs + cilium eBPF shouldn't hit iptables chains but we saw CONNTRACK backlog.
alex: I'm scheduling rollback now. Expect ~30m to restore. Will post updates.
devops-bot: action: rollback-cilium to v1.13 initiated by alex at 1748125200
alex: rollback complete on 12 nodes, jobs recovering. Will monitor NCCL errors for 2 hours.
samir: followup: we should add e2e tests for MTU compatibility with tunneled overlays in our nightlies.
kevin: And run iperf and NCCL small-allreduce in canary pipelines.
julia: Great. Thanks everyone. Next steps: write postmortem if incident hits >2hrs.
maria: noted. I'll make an incident stub in incidents channel.
alex: closing for now, will re-open if new occurrences surface. :thumbsup:
